result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall with no critical defects. Only a minor styling inconsistency was noticed.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icon styling is inconsistent between cards. On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card the heart appears as a plain white outline with no background circle, while on the pizza card below it the heart sits inside a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent heart icon treatment (same background/contrast) across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.
